requirements.requirement: Guests on lan-b (node3) must be able to reach services node1 itself offers them, such as DNS
requirements.summary: nslookup from node3 against node1's lan-b IP (10.10.2.1) succeeded both before restarts (cmd-60147ba90be54a85) and after all three nodes were restarted (cmd-c388c000a1064b57, cmd-22256615067640e9). Firewall rules explicitly ACCEPT DNS(53 udp/tcp) and DHCP(67 udp) from the lanb zone into node1 (cmd-c3d4c596dbfc48bc), and dnsmasq was confirmed listening on 10.10.2.1:53 post-restart in the fixed after_executor snapshot (global:after_executor:node1:listening-sockets).

requirements.requirement: No host on lan-b (node3) may open a connection to any host on lan-a (node2)
requirements.summary: ICMP ping from node3 to node2 was rejected with 'Destination Port Unreachable' both pre- and post-restart (cmd-60147ba90be54a85, cmd-22256615067640e9, cmd-c388c000a1064b57), and a direct TCP connect attempt to a non-service port (8899) on node2 from node3 was refused (cmd-fbd9fefe4561402c). The firewall zone 'lanb' is configured with forward=REJECT and only DNS/DHCP input rules are opened (cmd-c3d4c596dbfc48bc), consistent with the observed behavior.

requirements.requirement: Trusted hosts on lan-a (node2) keep full access to lan-b (node3) in the other direction
requirements.summary: ICMP ping and TCP connect (nc to node3's sshd, port 22) from node2 to node3 succeeded both before restarts (cmd-b2a7e8ac11c84a7f, cmd-b535d4f7bf294b07) and after all restarts (cmd-18c52687d2b84c47, cmd-bd8c9aa4c2d04bcf), consistent with the lana zone forward=ACCEPT and lana->lanb forwarding rule (cmd-c3d4c596dbfc48bc).

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol on node1: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
requirements.summary: Executor's own timeline shows a healthy baseline (boot_id 581f763f, dnsmasq/firewall active, cmd-7271208ba0404c96), a restart acknowledgement after retrying past a missing-nohup failure (cmd-df3683b116874b2f), and a changed boot_id (f6031a07, cmd-9307e3ac7bed46d4) with UCI/dnsmasq config and isolation behavior reconfirmed (cmd-785b2b58d49d438f). However, the independent fixed after_executor snapshot could not observe node1's boot-identity at all (SSH 'Connection reset by peer', global:after_executor:node1:boot-identity, return_code 255), so the cross-check protocol was not fully corroborated even though the executor's own in-band evidence is coherent.

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol on node2: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
requirements.summary: Baseline boot_id 28ae5f98 (cmd-7a7fd0286b2f4ff8), restart ack (cmd-1f1be8be67a7430b), expected connection timeout during reboot (cmd-e9476833556340a5), then new boot_id 1187a75e confirmed (cmd-2965b627920e4f66), matching the independent fixed after_executor snapshot (global:after_executor:node2:boot-identity). Post-restart recovered state (DHCP lease, static route, DNS, trusted->guest ping) reverified (cmd-18c52687d2b84c47).

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol on node3: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
requirements.summary: Baseline boot_id bdd5de93 (cmd-adceae1dbaaf471b), restart ack (cmd-27d7e68da7ad4779), expected connection timeout during reboot (cmd-4f0f6298d5a04610), then new boot_id 5a569701 confirmed (cmd-13d3c678b92b49fd), matching the independent fixed after_executor snapshot (global:after_executor:node3:boot-identity). Post-restart recovered state (DHCP lease, static route, DNS, guest isolation) reverified (cmd-c388c000a1064b57).

requirements.requirement: Provider management path (mgmt/10.100.69.0/24) preserved and not used as inter-node control plane
requirements.summary: Node3 successfully pinged node2's management IP (10.100.69.11) over the shared 10.100.69.0/24 network (cmd-700dbc5222f54bb3), and no executor commands modified mgmt-network configuration; each node was addressed and restarted directly rather than proxied through another node.

overall_summary: The material outcomes of the task — guest (lan-b/node3) access to node1's own DNS service, guest inability to reach lan-a (node2) trusted hosts, and full trusted-to-guest access in the other direction — are all directly and repeatedly demonstrated, both pre- and post-restart, through concrete ping/nslookup/nc tests with expected pass/fail outcomes matching the firewall zone configuration (lana ACCEPT-all, lanb REJECT input/forward with narrow DNS/DHCP allow rules). All three nodes were restarted with clear pre/post boot-identity transitions and recovered service state, though the independent fixed after_executor snapshot could not observe node1's boot-identity due to a transient SSH connection reset, slightly weakening (but not contradicting) that specific cross-check. The shared management network was verified intact and unused as an inter-node control path. Operational hygiene is high: the only non-persistent mutation (a temporary nc listener) was cleanly reverted, and manual IP/link commands used for discovery were superseded by the final persistent configuration.
limitations: The fixed after_executor lifecycle snapshot could not capture node1's boot-identity (SSH 'Connection reset by peer'), so the independent cross-check for node1's restart could not fully corroborate the executor's own in-band boot_id comparison, even though that in-band evidence (581f763f -> f6031a07) is internally coherent.
No prepare phase was configured for this task (prepare.enabled=false), so before_prepare and after_prepare snapshots are identical aliases; all observed changes are attributable to the executor.

operational_hygiene.summary: Executor commands were largely diagnostic or directly tied to the isolation/routing configuration. One bounded, low-risk diagnostic mutation was made and fully reverted: a background `nc -lk -p 8899` listener started on node2 for connectivity testing (cmd-bda0db4c6e7f4bce) was killed and its log file removed shortly after (cmd-ffc6e7e2c50a4449). Manual `ip addr add`/`ip link set` commands on node1/node2/node3 (cmd-49ff42d01f994674, cmd-4a041ccfa3704fc9, cmd-27cbf37ef80741a2, cmd-5b003ba4656a4d60) were transient scratch steps later superseded by persistent UCI and systemd-networkd configuration achieving the same addressing, so they left no inconsistent residue. Two failed reboot attempts on node1 due to a missing `nohup` binary (cmd-207e164e14754a24, cmd-900d9bb2c0d64345) were read-only-adjacent retries with no destructive effect, corrected by cmd-df3683b116874b2f. No failed services, no unnecessary package changes, and no evidence of unnecessary or unreverted mutations beyond the routine transient test listener.
